issues.description: Repeated 500 Internal Server Error responses from the server, appearing consistently across multiple console log entries. These are server-side errors affecting resource loading.
issues.root_cause: A resource (likely an API route or image/font endpoint) is returning HTTP 500. The console shows multiple consecutive 500 errors. Given the auth page mount events appearing alongside these, it's likely an API route under /api/ or a server component that is crashing. Also a 400 error appears once, suggesting a bad request to some endpoint.

issues.description: Console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative, fixed, or absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' This indicates a scroll-related component has a positioning issue.
issues.root_cause: A component using scroll offset calculation (likely the 'See how it works ↓ SCROLL' element or a parallax/scroll library component) is mounted inside a statically positioned container. The parent div needs position: relative.

issues.description: The page:mount event for 'auth' is firing repeatedly (8+ times visible in logs) which suggests either a redirect loop or a component re-mounting excessively on the auth page, though this does not visually affect the landing page.
issues.root_cause: The auth page component is re-mounting repeatedly, possibly due to a useEffect with missing/wrong dependencies or a StrictMode double-invoke combined with state changes causing infinite re-render.
